mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts (HOUST) indicate strengthening residential demand, which typically signals improving economic conditions and corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) in periods when HOUST growth exceeds 1.0% MoM, or the Rank IC falls below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5% annually, it signals a restrictive monetary policy stance that increases discount rates for equities, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and decline in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates a deteriorating labor market and weakening economic activity, which triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) in periods when UNRATE rises > 0.2pp and INDPRO falls > 0.5% MoM, or the Rank IC is below 0.04 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% YoY), a stable or rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals persistent monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 3.0% YoY and FEDFUNDS is stable or rising, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong non-farm payroll growth (PAYEMS) indicates robust labor market conditions and rising consumer spending, which typically supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) in periods when PAYEMS growth exceeds 0.5% MoM, or the Rank IC falls below 0.04 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When retail sales growth (RSAFS) falls below 0.5% MoM, it signals weakening consumer demand, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS growth is below 0.5% MoM, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 2.5% YoY) and a non-cutting federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS unchanged or rising) indicates persistent inflationary pressure and restrictive monetary policy, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 2.5% YoY and FEDFUNDS is unchanged or rising, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a recessionary regime (GDPC1 contraction), a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals worsening economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when GDPC1 is contracting and INDPRO is falling, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.
